page.notes: The page number reads "172" but the first digit and the last are slightly worn, so it is marked [?]. The running head is a heavy decorative line that I could not read letter by letter. In "euentus", the printed hyphen falls after "eue", so the break is marked as printed; the last letters are not fully clear. "pupillariter" has no printed hyphen at the line end and is written whole. The catchword "&" is the only word below the text.
